name: Weighted Straight Bar Dip
steps: While standing, fasten the plate to a dip belt and check that its attachment is closed.
Take an overhand grip on a bar you can mount into straight-arm support without jumping.
Lean your chest over the bar and bend your elbows behind you, keeping the plate from swinging.
Press down to straighten your arms and dismount under control before detaching the plate.
tips: Control the depth and keep the added weight steady rather than swinging beneath the bar.
Keep your shoulders depressed down away from your ears throughout each press.
